risk_note: RV2 by path (content, platform/config, contracts, test/spec, infra/staging). client-config now delivers bridge_origins as {jws}: an ES256 JWS over {v, app_id, env, version, origins}, signed deterministically (RFC 6979 via @noble/curves p256, compact r||s) so the strong ETag stays stable; saving the config.risk key validates https origins and requires the h5_base_url origin; the signing key is read from CONFIG_SIGN_KEY_FILE / CONFIG_SIGN_KEY_ID (local generates one at start; staging and prod refuse to start without it); staging compose mounts /etc/couli-config-sign read-only into api only. No amounts, no ledger, no payouts.
